name: praja-electric-monorepo
description: Praja Electric & Automation — Monorepo (Frontend + Backend + Admin)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND,ADMIN -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
